description: Grounding a target instruction in a global view to guide contact-aided endoscope navigation.
alt: EBV-CAN robotic platform, bird’s-eye view and language-grounded navigation setup.
overview: EBV-CAN combines a single initial bird’s-eye image with evolving endoscopic observations and motor state. Language-conditioned spatial queries locate the tip, next waypoint and target, connecting scene grounding to bending and insertion commands.
title: EBV-CAN: Vision–Language Grounding for Contact-Aided Endoscope Navigation
authors: Chi Kit Ng*, Shuchang Liu*, Jinsong Lin*, Yidong Zhang, Xizi Wang, Ho Yin Chim, Hongliang Ren†.

description: Anticipating navigation retreat by relating motor intent, distal motion and the endoscopic view.
alt: MPRF model combining commands, electromagnetic tracking and endoscopic video.
overview: Multimodal Progress-Residual Fusion anticipates an operator’s retreat decision from motor commands, electromagnetic tracking and endoscopic video. A nominal-progress model provides an intent–response residual that is fused with the observed modalities in a temporal predictor.
title: Multimodal Progress-Residual Fusion for Anticipating Navigation Retreat in Robotic Flexible Endoscopy
authors: Chi Kit Ng*, Tianchun Wu*, Jiatan Sun*, Yuming Sun, Jianru Zhang, Hongliang Ren†.

description: Following a language instruction to find a target beyond the current field of view, then track it.
alt: EndoVLA-OOV language-conditioned search and tracking for out-of-view targets.
overview: EndoVLA-OOV addresses language-conditioned target acquisition when the requested target begins outside the endoscopic field of view. The policy couples searching with subsequent visual tracking, with demonstrations spanning phantom environments and ex-vivo evaluation.
title: EndoVLA-OOV: Language-Conditioned Out-of-View Target Acquisition in Robotic Endoscopy
authors: Chi Kit Ng*, Yidong Zhang*, Tianchun Wu*, Zhiqing Tang, Hanlin Zhao, Siu Hing Lui, Tao Yang, Jingsong Lin, Huxin Gao, Yeung Trevor, Raymond Tang, Hongliang Ren†.

description: Using physical outcomes and human feedback to recursively improve endoscopic robot policies.
alt: EndoRSI task, research, execution and evidence-driven policy improvement loop.
overview: EndoRSI links policy research to physical experimentation and evidence-driven revision. A coding agent proposes and analyses candidate policies, while a separate runtime handles human-authorised robot execution. Experimental outcomes and feedback inform subsequent policy improvement.
title: EndoRSI: Physical-Evidence-Driven Recursive Improvement of Endoscopic Robot Policies
authors: Chi Kit Ng*, Yidong Zhang*, Tianchun Wu, Siu Hing Lui, Hanlin Zhao, Huxin Gao, Hongliang Ren†.

description: One view, two possible actions: language selects forward navigation or urgent retraction.
alt: EndoLIFT uses language to distinguish advancing from retracting in the same visual scene.
title: EndoLIFT: Language-Disambiguated Latent-Conditioned Rectified Flow for Bidirectional Endoscopic Control
authors: Chi Kit Ng*, Yidong Zhang*, Lui Siu Hing*, Jinsong Lin*, Tianchun Wu, Ho Yin Chim, Zhiqing Tang, Tao Yang, Huxin Gao, Trevor Yeung, Raymond Shing-Yan Tang, Hongliang Ren†.

description: Prompt-conditioned tracking of polyps, abnormal mucosa and circumferential cutting markers.
alt: EndoVLA autonomous tracking driven by the surgeon’s instruction.
title: EndoVLA: Dual-Phase Vision-Language-Action for Precise Autonomous Tracking in Endoscopy
authors: Chi Kit Ng*, Long Bai*, Guankun Wang*, Yupeng Wang, Huxin Gao, Kun Yuan, Chenhan Jin, Tieyong Zeng, Hongliang Ren†.

description: Learning to use contact with a deformable stomach wall as guidance for navigation.
alt: Contact-aided navigation of a flexible robotic endoscope in a deformable stomach.
title: Contact-Aided Navigation of Flexible Robotic Endoscope Using Deep Reinforcement Learning in Dynamic Stomach
authors: Chi Kit Ng, Huxin Gao, Tian-Ao Ren, Jiewen Lai, Hongliang Ren†.
